parts.name: canon (characters & places)
parts.about: The AI sketches the book's main characters and places (Character & place maker: one sketch call, then one proposal per entry); Akọwe's checks and an AI reviewer approve each entry under the run's consent; exactly one ★ protagonist is set.

parts.name: characters (sheets & voices)
parts.about: Every approved character gets a character sheet (wants, needs, fears, secrets) and a voice card; usually made with the character, otherwise the AI writes them now; then the voice cards are checked to really differ (never blocks the book).

parts.name: looks
parts.about: Before chapter one, one AI call decides only the essentials: how each character looks and talks under pressure (never blocks the book: what fails is asked again with the next chapter).

parts.name: pictures
parts.about: A portrait of every character and the full set for the ★ protagonist, made with Stable Diffusion through AutoInjector's image bridge; the first portrait becomes the character lock. Never holds up the book: what cannot be made goes on the Book Bible's to-make list.

parts.name: world (story rules & world texture)
parts.about: The AI drafts the story-rules ledger (what is law, seen, believed, a mystery) and the world-texture list. Story rules pause on a timeout / busy AI; since PR #157 a texture timeout is noted (TEXTURE_LATER) and tried once more after the outline (TEXTURE_RETRIED / TEXTURE_FAILED).
